profiles.simulator_phase2.5_scale_validation: simulator/ Phase-2.5 anatomical SCALE VALIDATION (anatomy.registry.json ONLY; schema 1.0->1.1): draw weights upgraded from purely ORDINAL to EVIDENCE-ANCHORED schematic. Default (human) draw_weight = log10(representative_um): SC log10(18.3)=1.26, viable epidermis log10(56.6)=1.75, dermis log10(2000)=3.30 (2000=flagged DISPLAY anchor=midpoint of cited 1-3mm range, NOT a measurement); subcutis 2.0 ILLUSTRATIVE/orientation-only; skin_surface 0.3 interface strip. Added thickness_evidence per layer per species (human/rat/mouse: representative_um,range_um,site,source,confidence), weight_profiles (human_contextual default / rat / mouse - kept SEPARATE, NO universal average invented), model_scope (multi_model=true), weight_basis. not_to_scale RETAINED (dynamic range ~100x -> log-compressed schematic; 'schematic - not to scale' caption kept). Literature (by species, not mixed): human SC 18.3um forearm + viable epidermis 56.6um (Sandby-Moller 2003 PubMed 14690333, HIGH); human dermis 1-3mm (consensus, MEDIUM/wide); rodent viable epidermis ~20um (PMC5620574 CC BY); mouse total skin ~540um (Annex JVSAH). Rat/mouse per-layer SC & dermis um NOT located -> those profiles stay ORDINAL, flagged INCOMPLETE, NOT invented; subcutis NOT anchored. NOTHING averaged across sources. anatomyModel accessors added (profiles/defaultProfile/weightsForSpecies/hasThicknessEvidence) - all read registry, no hardcoded biology. Scale levels/clip/labels/zoom/scenes UNCHANGED; NO biology/particles/motion/rendering added. 139/139 simulator tests pass; tsc compiles; hidden-char clean; production web/R/app/tests diff vs main EMPTY; production tests green (99 JS + 11 R). Auditable evidence: docs/profile-b-anatomy-scale-validation.md; report: docs/profile-b-simulator-phase2.5-implementation.md.
profiles.simulator_phase2.6_multi_species: simulator/ Phase-2.6 MULTI-SPECIES ANATOMY ARCHITECTURE (anatomy.registry.json schema 1.1->1.2 + AnatomyModel + config/state/main wiring; architectural refinement BEFORE Phase 3). Made the anatomy engine SPECIES-DRIVEN with INDEPENDENT human/mouse/rat profiles; the active profile ALWAYS follows the selected species; NO silent fallback to human (unsupported species = ERROR). Replaced Phase-2.5 model_scope+weight_profiles with species_scope {supported:[human,mouse,rat], initial:human (boot selection NOT a fallback), fallback:null} and independent species_profiles (each: layer_order, prominence, draw_weights, subcutis_present, weight_basis, confidence, references, uncertainty). Human EVIDENCE-ANCHORED (log10 um: SC 1.26/epi 1.75/dermis 3.30, HIGH); mouse/rat ORDINAL prominence ladder (very_thin 0.7/thin 1.2/medium 2.0/thick 2.8) because per-layer rodent um NOT established -> only ORDERING+prominence claimed, LOW-MEDIUM. INDEPENDENCE: none of human's 1.26/1.75/3.30 appears in rodents; mouse dermis 2.0 (medium) vs rat 2.8 (thick, rat skin thicker overall); mouse/rat share rodent SC 0.7/epi 1.2 (literature doesn't distinguish); skin_surface 0.3 = shared non-biological interface strip. NOT copied human->rodent; NOTHING averaged; nothing invented. AnatomyModel: activeSpecies + species()/initialSpecies()/profileFor()/setSpecies()/subcutisPresent()/weightsForSpecies() (THROWS on unknown - no human fallback)/weights() follows activeSpecies. config anatomy.species='human' boot selection; state.species tracked; app.setSpecies() redraws (prepares future Species selector, NO UI redesign). Layout/renderer UNCHANGED (already reads model.weights()); scenes/labels/zoom/clip UNCHANGED; NO biology/particles/motion/rendering added. 173/173 simulator tests pass; tsc compiles; hidden-char clean; production diff vs main EMPTY; production tests green (99 JS + 11 R). Audit: docs/profile-b-multi-species-anatomy.md; report: docs/profile-b-simulator-phase2.6-implementation.md.
profiles.simulator_phase3_transport: simulator/ Phase-3 BIOLOGICAL TRANSPORT ENGINE (first biology; transport ONLY - NO drug release/cell entry/uptake/endocytosis/payload/PK/PD). Simulates PASSIVE topical NLC carrier transport THROUGH skin: state machine Topical Formulation->Skin Surface->Stratum Corneum->Viable Epidermis->Dermis->Target Region. New: simulator/data/transport.registry.json (evidence backbone: 6 states + 5 cited transitions + mechanisms + barriers + species_transport + particle spec + integrity); src/biology/ transportStates.js (BiologicalStateMachine, validated linear+cited), transportModel.js (mobility/mechanisms/species/evidence accessors), particle.js (independent Particle objects: id/species/charge/pos/vel/state/layer/transportStatus/evidenceTag/crossings), transportEngine.js (PURE deterministic sim: Brownian + concentration drift x evidence-based per-layer mobility; species-driven depth bands from anatomy weights; EVIDENCE GATE), transportAnimator.js (rAF browser / tick+runHeadless tests), rng.js (seeded mulberry32); canvasRenderer extended with flat-dot particle overlay (NO glow/trail/FX) mapped through the zoom window; types/transport.ts. MECHANISMS passive only (Brownian, concentration-driven, SC barrier slowing, post-SC mobility increase); active_transport EXCLUDED. Barrier mobility SCHEMATIC_ORDINAL SC 0.15 < viable epidermis 0.5 < dermis 1.0 (ordering evidence-based; each has biological rationale+refs; NOT arbitrary; per-layer D NOT REPORTED). EVIDENCE-GATED + SPECIES-DRIVEN, NO fallback: ONLY RAT supported (Chen 2012 ex-vivo full-thickness abdominal rat skin permeation 1-12h, sections 0-90um, NLC 84.5-90.2nm); HUMAN blocked (HaCaT uptake only, NOT permeation = NOT_REPORTED); MOUSE blocked (C57BL/6 melanoma PD, NOT permeation = NOT_REPORTED). Integrity flags: intact-NP-vs-drug uncertain (Chen measured DRUG permeation; schematic carrier depiction), schematic timing (no flux/lag/D invented), topical=NO circulation, not_to_scale, excluded_downstream list. app.transport wired; app.setSpecies drives engine (rat animates, human/mouse blocked, 0 particles). 293/293 simulator tests pass (rat 14/14 particles arrive in-order crossing SC barrier; human/mouse blocked no-op; determinism; renderer frame; anatomy unchanged); tsc compiles; hidden-char clean; production diff vs main EMPTY; production tests green (99 JS + 11 R). Docs: docs/profile-b-simulator-phase3-implementation.md + profile-b-transport-architecture.md + profile-b-biological-transport.md + profile-b-transport-evidence-report.md + profile-b-transport-validation-report.md.

profiles.name: Intact nanoparticle penetration in a tumour spheroid (carrier transport)
profiles.purpose: size-dependent intact-carrier penetration benchmark (uptake-return, not pure Fickian)
profiles.profile_level: LEVEL_2_RESEARCH_SUPPORTED_SUBMODEL (mechanistic benchmark; PRIMARY VERIFIED this batch via Huang 2012)
profiles.primary_source: huang-2012-aunp-spheroid (ACS Nano 2012;6(5):4483-4493, DOI 10.1021/nn301282m) - opened batch-2. Replaces the unverified Chen-2024 dossier target as the anchor.
profiles.carrier_note: Huang uses Au@tiopronin 2.6/6.1/14.8 nm (MEASURED); different system from the Chen-2024 (15/22/60 nm) dossier target, which remains unopened.

cell_uptake.label: CARRIER_SPECIFIC
cell_uptake.values: ICP-MS Au/cell (quantitative); smaller NP -> more uptake; 1 nM, MCF-7

penetration_depth.label: BENCHMARK
penetration_depth.values: 2 & 6 nm penetrate spheroid core + cytoplasm/nucleus; 15 nm peripheral
penetration_depth.note: SEMI-QUANTITATIVE (dark-field/TEM imaging); NOT a concentration-vs-radius profile

in_vivo_tumour.label: CARRIER_SPECIFIC
in_vivo_tumour.note: MCF-7 tumour mice, single IV, ICP-MS accumulation (n=3)

transport_mechanism.label: MECHANISTIC_TRANSFER
transport_mechanism.note: size-dependent extracellular<->cell uptake; supports a benchmark, not a fitted uptake-return rate model (imaging only)

api_release.label: INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE
api_release.note: NO API present - intact gold carrier only; never present as therapeutic API penetration

profiles.stage3_label: RESEARCH_SUPPORTED intact-carrier size-dependent penetration BENCHMARK (Au@tiopronin, MCF-7) - carrier transport only, NOT API delivery; spatial outputs qualitative/ranking
profiles.residual_gaps: no concentration-vs-radius calibration (imaging only); Huang SI (Figs S1-S3) not provided; no independent external validation; Chen-2024 (15/22/60 nm) still optional for a second size range

governing_equation.note: verified from user-provided primary images pp.335-339

permeability_intermediate.note: 10kDa=32, 70kDa=9.8 (x1e-7) from dossier/Fig3, not in the text pages provided

species_relevance.label: BENCHMARK

profiles.name: PEGylated liposomal doxorubicin (Doxil) systemic PK + tumour delivery
profiles.purpose: clinically established nanoformulation; modular composite (formulation+PK now PRIMARY VERIFIED from FDA label; local tumour transport still missing)
profiles.profile_level: LEVEL_3_RESEARCH_SUPPORTED_COMPOSITE (formulation+systemic PK DIRECT_EXACT this batch; tumour-transport module INSUFFICIENT)
profiles.primary_sources: doxil-fda-pi (DailyMed PI Baxter rev 3/2026 + NDA 050718/S-060 authorized-generic label rev 5/2022, identical values), doxil-nda050718-s050 (FDA approval package incl. Clinical Pharmacology/Biopharmaceutics review + BE study DOXILNAP1004), barenholz-2012 (J Control Release 160:117-134) - all opened this batch (aids E1, E3)

formulation.label: DIRECT_EXACT
formulation.values: per mL: doxorubicin HCl 2 mg (=1.87 mg dox base); cholesterol 3.19 mg; HSPC 9.58 mg; MPEG-DSPE(PEG2000) 3.19 mg; ammonium sulfate ~0.6 mg; histidine 1.55 mg; sucrose 94 mg; pH 6.0-7.0; >90% encapsulated; dox HCl MW 579.99
formulation.note: label gives composition but NOT liposome diameter (~100 nm from Barenholz)

particle_size.label: BENCHMARK
particle_size.note: PEGylated unilamellar liposome <100 nm (~100 nm); label itself omits size

systemic_PK.label: DIRECT_EXACT
systemic_PK.values: total dox: Cmax 4.12/8.34 ug/mL; CL 0.056/0.041 L/h/m2; Vss 2.83/2.72 L/m2; AUC 277/590 ug/mL.h; lambda1 t1/2 4.7/5.2 h; lambda2 t1/2 52.3/55.0 h at 10/20 mg/m2; linear 10-20, nonlinear at 50 mg/m2
systemic_PK.note: contrast: conventional doxorubicin Vd 700-1100 L/m2, CL 24-35 L/h/m2 (label)

free_vs_encapsulated.label: DIRECT_PARTIAL
free_vs_encapsulated.values: >=90% remains encapsulated in circulation; FDA S-050 mass-balance free estimate unreliable (42% negative). Li 2022 DIRECTLY assays free (SPE): free Cmax 133/114 ng/mL vs encapsulated Cmax 34.37/33.73 ug/mL; free t1/2 97 h vs encapsulated 81 h; BE established for BOTH free & encapsulated (GMR 90% CI within 80-125%)
free_vs_encapsulated.note: Li 2022 (reference=Caelyx=EU Doxil twin) gives directly-measured free-dox PK - more defensible than mass balance. DIRECT_PARTIAL (Caelyx ref, different trial than US label)

remote_loading_mechanism.label: MECHANISTIC_TRANSFER
remote_loading_mechanism.note: QSPR (60 drugs/366 experiments) supports ammonium-sulfate remote loading; modeling support only, not release/PK data

metabolism.label: DIRECT_EXACT
metabolism.values: doxorubicinol 0.8-26.2 ng/mL plasma at 10/20 mg/m2; plasma protein binding of doxorubicin ~70% (Doxil not determined)

tumour_accumulation.label: INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE
tumour_accumulation.note: label/reviews give NO spatial tumour penetration; Barenholz cites (secondary) malignant-effusion levels 4-16x free-dox from Gabizon [96]. Need primary intratumoral-distribution study (aid E4/Charrois-Allen aid E5)

local_release.label: ASSUMED
local_release.note: in-vitro release/dissolution profiles exist in S-050 but numeric values REDACTED (b)(4); release mechanism qualitative (Barenholz koff)

in_vitro_release_method.label: DIRECT_PARTIAL
in_vitro_release_method.note: dissolution timepoints 0.5/1.5/3/6 h, f2 similarity used; VALUES redacted as trade secret

validation.label: INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE
validation.note: S-050 shows site-to-site BE (GSK vs BVL, encapsulated+total dox) but NO independent biological/tumour validation

profiles.stage3_label: RESEARCH_SUPPORTED liposomal-doxorubicin systemic-PK + formulation submodel (DIRECT_EXACT from FDA label) - tumour-penetration outputs MUST stay disabled (no spatial primary)
